jobs.title: Field Service Application Specialist
jobs.description:
Field Service Applications Specialist

Field-Based | Full-Time

Florida - VA Region | Up to 50% Travel

Make an Impact With Our Team

Are you passionate about laboratory automation, scientific applications, and helping customers maximize the value of their liquid handling systems? We are seeking a Field Service Applications Specialist (FSAS) to serve as the post-sale technical expert supporting Liquid Handling automation platforms throughout the Americas.

In this role, you will partner closely with Field Automation Engineers, Application Scientists, Product Management, and customers to deliver application-based automation solutions that integrate software, hardware, and biological workflows. You will provide advanced technical expertise throughout the customer lifecycle, including application development, installation support, troubleshooting, training, and workflow optimization.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and supporting innovative laboratory automation technologies, we encourage you to apply.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Become a technical expert in Liquid Handling automation, providing advanced application support throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Support both pre-sale and post-sale activities by evaluating customer applications and recommending automation solutions.

• Design, configure, and implement application-based solutions using software, scripting, hardware, and laboratory workflows.

• Collaborate with Field Automation Engineers to shift customer discussions from product features toward application-driven solutions.

• Provide application analysis, workflow configuration, instrument demonstrations, installation support, and advanced troubleshooting.

• Deliver technical training and application support to Field Automation Engineers and members of the service organization.

• Partner with Product Management and Applications teams to communicate customer feedback and field requirements.

• Serve as the primary technical resource for complex application issues involving liquid handling automation platforms.

• Assist customers with programming, workflow optimization, and application-specific problem resolution.

• Maintain awareness of emerging scientific technologies, laboratory workflows, and automation trends.

• Travel extensively throughout the Americas and internationally as needed to support customer installations, training, and service activities.

• Ensure compliance with company quality systems, safety policies, and regulatory requirements.

• Complete assigned projects while maintaining high standards for documentation, communication, and customer satisfaction.

What You Bring

• Strong customer-focused communication and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation abilities.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced technical environment.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to conceptualize and develop application-based automation solutions.

• Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across technical and commercial teams.

• High level of initiative, accountability, and professionalism.

• Ability to thrive under pressure while maintaining exceptional customer service.

• Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with scientific literature and emerging technologies.

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%, including regional and international travel.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biology, Computer Science, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum of two years of experience with laboratory automation or liquid handling systems in academic or industry environments.

• Experience developing automation applications using native instrument software or programming languages.

• Hands-on experience with automated laboratory instrumentation.

• Knowledge of molecular biology workflows including:

• Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) sample preparation

• PCR and qPCR setup

• Nucleic acid purification

• DNA/RNA quantification and normalization

• Experience supporting customers in technical or scientific environments.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows applications.

Nice to Have

• Experience with VBScript, VBA, and .NET programming.

• Experience designing and implementing laboratory automation workflows.

• Background supporting Field Service Engineers or Application Scientists.

• Experience delivering customer training and technical presentations.

• Knowledge of liquid handling programming, scripting, and workflow optimization.

• Familiarity with third-party laboratory instruments and reagent integration.

• Experience collaborating with Product Management and cross-functional technical teams.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Paid time off and company holidays.

• Professional development and technical training opportunities.

• Career growth within a global leader in laboratory automation.

• Collaborative and innovative team environment.

• Opportunity to support cutting-edge technologies advancing life science research worldwide.

Salary range: $100K– $125K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Specialista di applicazioni di servizio sul campo Field-Based | Full-Time Florida - VA Region | Fino al 50% Viaggi Fare un impatto con il nostro team Sei appassionato di automazione di laboratorio, applicazioni scientifiche e di aiutare i clienti a massimizzare il valore dei loro sistemi di gestione dei liquidi? Stiamo cercando un Field Service Applications Specialist (FSAS) per servire come esperto tecnico post-vendita che supporta piattaforme di automazione Liquid Handling in tutte le Americhe. In questo ruolo, partnerrai a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri di automazione di campo, gli scienziati delle applicazioni, la gestione dei prodotti e i clienti per fornire soluzioni di automazione basate sulle applicazioni che integrano software, hardware e flussi di lavoro biologici. Fornirai competenze tecniche avanzate durante il ciclo di vita del cliente, tra cui sviluppo delle applicazioni, supporto di installazione, risoluzione dei problemi, formazione e ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro. Se ti piace risolvere complesse sfide tecniche, lavorare direttamente con i clienti e supportare tecnologie di automazione di laboratorio innovative, ti invitiamo a applicare. Come farai ad avere un impatto?
• Diventa un esperto tecnico nell'automazione Liquid Handling, fornendo un supporto avanzato all'applicazione durante il ciclo di vita del cliente.
• Supporta sia le attività pre-vendita che post-vendita valutando le applicazioni dei clienti e raccomandando soluzioni di automazione.
• Progettare, configurare e implementare soluzioni basate su applicazioni utilizzando software, scripting, hardware e flussi di lavoro di laboratorio.
• Collabora con gli ingegneri di automazione del campo per spostare le discussioni dei clienti dalle caratteristiche del prodotto verso le soluzioni basate sulle applicazioni.
• Fornire analisi delle applicazioni, configurazione del flusso di lavoro, dimostrazioni degli strumenti, supporto di installazione e risoluzione avanzata dei problemi.
• Fornire formazione tecnica e supporto alle applicazioni a Field Automation Engineers e membri dell'organizzazione di servizio.
• Partner con i team di Product Management e Applications per comunicare i requisiti di feedback e campo dei clienti.
• Servire come risorsa tecnica primaria per problemi di applicazione complessi che coinvolgono piattaforme di automazione di gestione liquida.
• Assistere i clienti con programmazione, ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e risoluzione dei problemi specifici delle applicazioni.
• Mantenere la consapevolezza delle tecnologie scientifiche emergenti, dei flussi di lavoro di laboratorio e delle tendenze di automazione.
• Viaggia in tutta l'America e a livello internazionale come necessario per supportare le installazioni dei clienti, la formazione e le attività di servizio.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei sistemi di qualità aziendale, politiche di sicurezza e requisiti normativi.
• Progetti assegnati completi mantenendo elevati standard per la documentazione, la comunicazione e la soddisfazione del cliente. Che cosa porta
• Forte comunicazione focalizzata sul cliente e capacità di costruzione di relazioni.
• Eccellente capacità scritte, verbali e di presentazione.
• Forte pensiero analitico e capacità di problem solving.
• Capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente tecnico veloce.
• Eccellente capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo.
• Capacità di concettualizzare e sviluppare soluzioni di automazione basate sulle applicazioni.
• Forte capacità di follow-up e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Mindset collaborativo con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e commerciali.
• Alto livello di iniziativa, responsabilità e professionalità.
• Capacità di prosperare sotto pressione mantenendo un servizio clienti eccezionale.
• Impegno all'apprendimento continuo e alla corrente con la letteratura scientifica e le tecnologie emergenti.
• Volontà e capacità di viaggiare fino al 50%, compresi i viaggi regionali e internazionali. Il tuo sfondo
• Laurea in ingegneria biomedica, biologia, informatica, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.
• Minimo di due anni di esperienza con sistemi di automazione di laboratorio o di manipolazione liquida in ambienti accademici o industriali.
• Esperienza di sviluppo applicazioni di automazione utilizzando software di strumenti nativi o linguaggi di programmazione.
• Esperienza pratica con strumentazione di laboratorio automatizzata.
• Conoscenza dei flussi di lavoro di biologia molecolare tra cui:
• Preparazione del campione di prossima generazione (NGS)
• Configurazione PCR e qPCR
• purificazione dell'acido nucleico
• quantificazione del DNA/RNA e normalizzazione
• Esperienza di supporto ai clienti in ambienti tecnici o scientifici.
• Forte conoscenza di funzionamento delle applicazioni Microsoft Windows. Bello da avere
• Esperienza con la programmazione VBScript, VBA e .NET.
• Progettazione e realizzazione di flussi di lavoro di automazione di laboratorio.
• Background che supporta gli ingegneri del servizio di campo o gli scienziati dell'applicazione.
• Esperienza che offre formazione clienti e presentazioni tecniche.
• Conoscenza della programmazione, scrittura e ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro.
• Familiarità con strumenti di laboratorio di terze parti e integrazione reagente.
• Esperienza di collaborazione con Product Management e team tecnici interfunzionali. Cosa offriamo
• Compensazione competitiva e pacchetto completo di benefici.
• Assicurazione medica, dentale e visione.
• 401(k) con fiammifero aziendale.
• Tempo pagato e vacanze aziendali.
• Sviluppo professionale e opportunità di formazione tecnica.
• Crescita di carriera all'interno di un leader globale nell'automazione di laboratorio.
• Ambiente di team collaborativo e innovativo.
• Opportunità di sostenere tecnologie all'avanguardia che promuovano la ricerca sulla scienza della vita in tutto il mondo. Gamma di insalata: $100K– $125K (Salario da determinare per l'istruzione, l'esperienza, la conoscenza, le competenze e le capacità del richiedente, l'equità interna e l'allineamento con i dati del settore.) Il nostro scopo. A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi. Rimanete unici e fatelo contare. I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare. Ente giuridico:

Männedorf, Zürich

As a Senior Manager Key Account Products, you are responsible to manage and oversee all business operations related to Key Account OEM customer products of Tecan’s IVD & Life Sciences Partnering Business. You are the key liaison for the customers to internal counterparts in R&D, Operations, Service, Quality and Regulatory. Responsibilities

• Act as central point of contact for Key Account customers for all day-to-day operational aspects regarding their Systems products, represent the client interests from development to end of life in internal teams

• Oversee operational life cycle management of existing products, ensuring customer satisfaction, compliance, documentation, and financial performance in close collaboration with the dedicated Sales counterpart

• Lead key client meetings like quarterly business reviews, quality reviews as well as internal product care meetings, steering meetings, with regular attendance of executives

• Guide customers through design and regulatory changes and global or local events impacting their business (e.g. tariffs)

• Maintain and manage budget, sales, and forecasts for assigned accounts, ensuring adherence to contract terms in collaboration with Sales

• Oversee product profitability and drive improvement measures with stakeholders

• Lead Product Care Team for assigned products and product families, defining and monitoring critical KPIs, regularly reporting to customers and Tecan management

• Implement corrective measures when KPIs deviate from targets, leading cross-functional teams to ensure success

• Apply your business mindset and client & market understanding to grow the partnership through driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products that align with the client’s needs

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and continuously seek improvements to Tecan processes

• Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion within the team and broader organization.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering; further education in Product Management, Project Management or Business Administration

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life sciences

• 5+ years’ experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and/or product/lifecycle management

• Experience working with customers/partners in a B2B setting, OEM experience is a plus

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and/or complex products (HW, SW, services)

• Expertise in negotiating complex contracts, particularly in development and supply agreements is a plus

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations

• Strong communication skills, experience in communication to executives is a plus

• Team-oriented, customer-focused, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated

• Willingness to travel worldwide (10–20%)

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Marketing Manager

Morgan Hill, CA 95037
 Full-Time | Exempt | Remote

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about developing strategic marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, generate demand, and support commercial growth? Join Tecan as a Marketing Manager, where you'll play a key role in positioning Tecan's CDMO offering, through integrated marketing campaigns, thought leadership, and close collaboration with global commercial teams.

In this role, you'll serve as the marketing partner between Product Management, Sales, Business Development, Regional Commercial Teams, Brand, and Internal Communications to strengthen customer engagement, optimize the sales funnel, and deliver measurable business results.

If you're a strategic, data-driven marketer who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and enjoys leading cross-functional initiatives, we'd love to hear from you.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Develop and execute strategic marketing plans for Tecan's Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations offering.

• Create messaging frameworks, value propositions, and market positioning aligned with business objectives.

• Design and implement integrated marketing campaigns, including Account-Based Marketing (ABM).

• Develop multi-channel marketing programs and content that drive awareness, engagement, demand generation, and commercial growth.

• Produce thought leadership content and executive communications to strengthen industry visibility.

• Gather customer, competitive, and market insights to inform marketing strategy.

• Manage assigned marketing budgets and maximize return on investment.

• Measure campaign performance, lead quality, conversion metrics, and marketing ROI using data-driven analysis.

• Support regional commercial teams with marketing initiatives and campaign execution.

• Develop sales enablement materials including presentations, brochures, case studies, campaign toolkits, and digital assets.

• Lead and support global events, customer events, webinars, and industry conferences.

• Maintain the Partnering Business presentation library and coordinate updates with Product Managers.

• Collaborate with Brand, Internal Communications, LSB Marketing, Sales, Business Development, and Global Regional Teams to ensure consistent messaging and execution.

• Drive continuous improvement of marketing effectiveness through cross-functional collaboration.

What You Bring

• Strong B2B marketing strategy and execution experience.

• Expertise in integrated marketing campaigns and Account-Based Marketing.

• Strong storytelling, messaging, and content development skills.

• Experience with demand generation and lead lifecycle management.

• Strong analytical mindset with experience measuring marketing performance and ROI.

• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience managing marketing budgets and agency relationships.

• Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, and project management skills.

• Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.

• Self-motivated with a hands-on approach and strong sense of ownership.

• Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.

Your Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.

• 5–7 years of B2B marketing experience.

• Experience working within multinational organizations.

• Experience developing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience with digital marketing channels including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media.

• Proficiency with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

• Experience with website content management systems (CMS).

• Technical writing experience.

• Experience analyzing marketing performance using dashboards and reporting tools.

• Strong English communication skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience within Life Sciences, Diagnostics, Biotechnology, or Medical Technology.

• Experience supporting OEM/CDMO organizations.

• Training or certification in Account-Based Marketing, Branding, or Project Management.

• AI for Marketing experience.

• Marketing Analytics expertise.

• Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or SAP C4C.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation tools.

• Customer journey mapping expertise.

• Additional language skills such as German.

• Creative thinking and innovation experience.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to travel approximately 20%.

Salary range: $100K– $125K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Responsabile marketing

Tempo pieno | Exempt | Remote

Fare un impatto su Tecan

Sei appassionato di sviluppare iniziative strategiche di marketing che spingono la consapevolezza del marchio, generano la domanda e supportano la crescita commerciale? Unisciti a Tecan come Marketing Manager, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo chiave nel posizionare l'offerta CDMO di Tecan, attraverso campagne di marketing integrate, leadership di pensiero e stretta collaborazione con team commerciali globali.

In questo ruolo, sarai il partner di marketing tra Product Management, Sales, Business Development, Regional Commercial Teams, Brand e Internal Communications per rafforzare il coinvolgimento dei clienti, ottimizzare l'imbuto di vendita e fornire risultati aziendali misurabili.

Se sei un marketer strategico e guidato dai dati che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce e gode di importanti iniziative interfunzionali, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

• Sviluppare ed eseguire piani strategici di marketing per l'offerta di Tecan Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations.

• Creare quadri di messaggistica, proposizioni di valore e posizionamento di mercato allineati con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Progettazione e realizzazione di campagne di marketing integrate, tra cui Account-Based Marketing (ABM).

• Sviluppare programmi di marketing multicanale e contenuti che animano la consapevolezza, l'impegno, la generazione della domanda e la crescita commerciale.

• Produrre contenuti di leadership pensiero e comunicazioni esecutive per rafforzare la visibilità del settore.

• Raccogliere clienti, competitivi e approfondimenti di mercato per informare la strategia di marketing.

• Gestire i budget di marketing assegnati e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Misura le prestazioni della campagna, la qualità del piombo, le metriche di conversione e il ROI di marketing utilizzando l'analisi data-driven.

• Sostenere le squadre commerciali regionali con iniziative di marketing e l'esecuzione delle campagne.

• Sviluppare materiali di attivazione delle vendite, tra cui presentazioni, brochure, studi di casi, strumenti di campagna e attività digitali.

• Guidare e sostenere eventi globali, eventi clienti, webinar e conferenze del settore.

• Mantenere la libreria di presentazione di Partnering Business e coordinare gli aggiornamenti con Product Manager.

• Collabora con brand, comunicazioni interne, marketing LSB, vendite, sviluppo aziendale e team regionali globali per garantire messaggistica ed esecuzione coerenti.

• Miglioramento continuo dell'efficacia del marketing attraverso la collaborazione interfunzionale.

Che cosa porta

• Forte strategia di marketing B2B e esperienza di esecuzione.

• Competenza in campagne di marketing integrate e Marketing basato su Account.

• Forte capacità di storytelling, messaggistica e sviluppo dei contenuti.

• Esperienza con la generazione della domanda e la gestione del ciclo di vita principale.

• Forte mentalità analitica con esperienza di misurazione delle prestazioni di marketing e ROI.

• Eccellente gestione degli stakeholder e competenze di collaborazione interfunzionali.

• Esperienza gestione budget di marketing e relazioni di agenzia.

• Capacità di dare priorità a più iniziative in un ambiente frenetico.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e project management.

• mentalità orientata al cliente con forte acume aziendale.

• Automotivata con un approccio pratico e un forte senso di proprietà.

• Adattabilità e miglioramento continuo.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea o Master in Marketing, Business Administration, o campo relativo.

• 5-7 anni di esperienza di marketing B2B.

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di organizzazioni multinazionali.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di strategie e campagne di marketing integrate.

• Esperienza con canali di marketing digitali tra cui SEO, SEM, email marketing e social media.

• Proficienza con piattaforme di automazione di marketing come HubSpot.

• Esperienza con Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

• Esperienza con i sistemi di gestione dei contenuti del sito web (CMS).

• Esperienza di scrittura tecnica.

• Esperienza di analisi delle prestazioni di marketing utilizzando dashboard e strumenti di reporting.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione inglese.

Bello da avere

• Esperienza all'interno di Scienze della Vita, Diagnostica, Biotecnologia o Tecnologia Medica.

• Esperienza che supporta le organizzazioni OEM/CDMO.

• Formazione o certificazione in Account-Based Marketing, Branding, o Project Management.

• AI per esperienza di marketing.

• Competenze di Marketing Analytics.

• Esperienza con piattaforme CRM come Salesforce o SAP C4C.

• Familiarità con strumenti di creazione di contenuti assistiti da AI.

• Esperienza di mappatura del viaggio del cliente.

• Ulteriori competenze linguistiche come il tedesco.

• Esperienza creativa di pensiero e innovazione.

Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di viaggiare circa il 20%.

Gamma di insalata: $100K– $125K
(Salario da determinare per l'istruzione, l'esperienza, la conoscenza, le competenze e le capacità del richiedente, l'equità interna e l'allineamento con i dati del settore.)

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, elevati standard e ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Sales team and bring your passion and talent to work !

We are looking for a motivated and organized individual to join our team as a Sales Specialist on a 1-year fixed-term contract.

In this role, you will play a key part in driving business growth by building strong customer relationships, identifying new sales opportunities, and supporting our customers throughout the sales journey in a dynamic and international environment.

Sales Specialist Detection – 100%
Location: Sweden

Fixed-term contract – 1 year

In this challenging and important role, you will be responsible for managing and growing sales of Tecan’s Detection solutions within your assigned territory. You will develop strong know-how in customer applications, instrument capabilities, user software, and provide demonstrations, presentations, and customer training. From prospecting to closing deals, you will ensure customer satisfaction and contribute to sustainable and ethical business growth.

Responsibilities

• Responsible and accountable for Detection sales performance in the assigned territory, including order entry and sales targets.

• Manage the sales process from prospecting and opportunity qualification through quotation, negotiation, order entry, and revenue recognition.

• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of Detection opportunities through active prospecting, customer visits, attendance at seminars and events, and collaboration with local sales teams.

• Provide technical and consultative sales support to understand customer needs, workflows, applications, and business objectives.

• Position and promote Tecan’s Detection portfolio, including microplate readers, washers, imaging, and related solutions, according to customer needs and application requirements.

• Perform or coordinate, in collaboration with pre-sales, customer demonstrations and product presentations to raise awareness of Tecan’s Detection solutions.

• Manage customer expectations and, where necessary, challenge whether requested solutions are realistic, practical, or aligned with Tecan’s capabilities.

• Prepare and submit customer documentation, including quotations, tender responses, RFQs, and supporting commercial documents.

• Ensure weekly and accurate updates of CRM, including opportunities, activities, forecast information, and next steps.

• Provide regional market intelligence on customer needs, competitor activity, pricing pressure, market trends, and emerging application areas.

• Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, strategic customers, partners, and relevant stakeholders to support business growth.

• Contribute to regional growth plans in line with overall company objectives and local business priorities.

• Support the installation process after receipt of sales order when required, including coordination with Service, Application Specialists, and Customer Operations.

• Provide initial customer training or coordinate appropriate training resources where applicable.

• Collaborate positively with other territories, local Sales, Service, Application Specialists, Sales Development, Marketing, Customer Operations, and Product Management.

• Identify cross-selling opportunities for Liquid Handling, Automation, Service, Consumables, and Reagents and hand them over to the responsible colleagues when appropriate.

• Ensure compliance with Tecan’s values, code of conduct, quality standards, and business processes.

• Embody Tecan’s values of Ambition, Trust, and Highest Standards.

Your Background

• Degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Engineering, Business, or equivalent professional experience in a relevant commercial or technical role.

• 2–3 years of professional experience in sales, business development, application support, or product specialist roles within life sciences, diagnostics, laboratory instrumentation, or a related field.

• Experience in customer-facing activities, including customer visits, presentations, demonstrations, seminars, and follow-up of commercial opportunities.

• Ability to understand customer workflows and translate technical requirements into suitable Tecan solutions.

• Experience using CRM systems to manage opportunities, pipeline, forecast, and customer activities.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in Swedish and English.

• Basic knowledge of detection technologies and applications such as absorbance, fluorescence, luminescence, ELISA, cell-based assays, and microplate-based workflows.

• Ability to present technical solutions, support customer demonstrations, and explain product benefits in a consultative sales context.

• Confident use of CRM systems and standard Microsoft Office tools.

Nice to Have:

• Advanced scientific background/PhD in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or comparable field.

• Experience with broader Tecan solutions (Liquid Handling, Automation, etc.).

Personal Attributes:

• Balanced business personality with both ambition and integrity.

• Team player.

• Effective communicator and persuasive presenter.

• Stress resistant with high flexibility, balancing both thinking and action.

What makes working at Tecan unique

• The chance to make it count and have an impact on the world of tomorrow.

• Working in an international and diverse environment.

• Opportunities to grow your career within the company.

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture.

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

VP, Head System Solutions R&D (80- 100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive the strategic direction of System Solutions R&D for Tecan’s complex life sciences and medical technology portfolio. You will shape the system architecture vision, oversee multidisciplinary teams, and ensure the integrity and excellence of our products across hardware, software, applications, automation, and regulated workflows. From concept to market launch and lifecycle management, you will be the senior leader ensuring our solutions are safe, effective, and ready for the world.

Responsibilities

• Provide strategic leadership for the System Solutions R&D function, setting vision and direction for systems engineering, architecture, integration, and application science.

• Own and maintain the system architecture, strategy, and technology roadmap across the product portfolio.

• Set standards for requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration across multidisciplinary teams.

• Partner with PMO, Product Management, Marketing, and Business Leaders to shape portfolio strategy and define product roadmaps.

• Lead early-stage technical due diligence, feasibility assessments, and risk evaluations for investment decisions.

• Champion best practices in design controls, risk management, verification, and validation.

• Provide executive technical oversight for integration, system verification, and release readiness decisions.

• Build and grow technical leadership within the function, including hiring, performance management, and talent development.

• Foster strong partnerships across functions and represent System Solutions in executive reviews and governance forums.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, technical excellence, and innovation.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Master’s degree preferred.

• Advanced business education or a business degree is a nice to have.

• 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, product development, and innovation within life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices, or other highly regulated industries.

• Proven success leading system architecture and cross-functional technical execution for complex multidisciplinary products.

• Strong track record of building and leading high-performing teams in global, matrixed organizations.

• Demonstrated senior leadership experience in building and developing multidisciplinary R&D organizations.

• Skilled at coaching, mentoring, and developing technical leaders within the organization.

• Comfortable leading across geographies and cultures, promoting diversity and inclusion.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Global Distributors team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA (100%)

Männedorf, Switzerland (with extensive travel across EMEA)

Your contribution

As the Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA, you will play a key role in driving Tecan’s growth across the EMEA region. You will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing distributor network, ensuring our partners are empowered to deliver advanced laboratory automation solutions to customers in life sciences, applied markets, and clinical diagnostics. By acting as a strategic link between market needs and Tecan’s internal teams, you will help shape business development and product innovation. Your efforts will ensure the successful positioning and adoption of complex technical solutions, while fostering strong, self-sufficient distributor relationships that support Tecan’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

• Lead the recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of distributor partners across EMEA.

• Develop and execute strategic business plans with each distributor, ensuring alignment with Tecan’s growth objectives.

• Own the full sales cycle—from opportunity generation to project delivery—acting as the primary interface between distribution partners and internal stakeholders.

• Support distributors in customer engagement, including joint visits, presentations, and negotiations.

• Monitor distributor performance, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of sales performance and profitability.

• Provide technical expertise in laboratory automation, instrument configuration, and integrated solutions.

• Deliver high-level technical presentations and participate in key customer discussions.

• Coordinate cross-functional internal stakeholders to ensure successful execution of complex and high-value projects.

• Travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region to support distributor and customer needs.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in technical or natural sciences (molecular biology, physics, engineering, or related fields).

• 5+ years’ experience in life sciences, diagnostics, or laboratory automation, with hands-on exposure to complex lab instruments or automation platforms.

• Proven track record managing or working with distributor networks (ideally across EMEA).

• Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, applications, and customer environments.

• Excellent communication skills in English; French, German, or Arabic are a plus.

• Willingness and ability to travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region.

• Strategic mindset, resilience, agility, and a collaborative approach to influencing without direct authority.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Partnering Business department and bring your passion and talent to work.

(Associate) Customer Product Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Customer Product Manager, you will be the primary liaison for coordinating and driving our Partnering Business partner products — with a special focus on customized solutions based on platform products— with all internal and external stakeholders. You will support the Partnering Business sales teams in contractual and pricing negotiations, outline value propositions, and drive alignment sessions. Your role involves managing trade-offs between client business demands, product life cycle stages, and Tecan business needs to create win/win positions. You will also contribute to the development of the Customer Product Management team with entrepreneurial thinking and market insights.

Responsibilities

• Manage and oversee all day-to-day lifecycle and operational aspects for assigned projects and products, including business and quality review meetings, regular conference calls, and product change management.

• Drive customer satisfaction and support Tecan’s Partnering Business marketing, financial, and growth objectives through operational excellence and proactive life cycle management.

• Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and maintain relevant product documentation.

• Monitor and manage product forecasting, orders, and deliveries, and drive necessary actions in alignment with key stakeholders.

• Lead the Product Care Team, manage product-related KPIs, and ensure on-time delivery of agreed items.

• Support the sales organization in preparing and negotiating contracts, and monitor contract expirations and obligations.

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and spot and identify client trends.

• Play a key role in efficiently managing the lifecycle of platform-based products by applying established processes and driving continuous improvement initiatives

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering, with further education in Product Management or Business Administration.

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life science business.

• Experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and product/lifecycle management.

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• Strong negotiation skills and experience in executing complex contracts.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations.

• Team-oriented, entrepreneurial thinking, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated.

• Willingness to travel worldwide (5-10%).

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle tragen Sie die technische Verantwortung für ein Produkteportfolio während dem Lifecycle-Management. • Initiierung und Umsetzung von mechanischen, elektronischen oder Softwareänderungen zusammen mit einem Team von Fachexperten.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Product Development team and bring your passion and talent to work.

CAD / PDM Administrator (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

Are you passionate about making a difference in how teams work with cutting-edge CAD and PDM systems? At Tecan, you’ll play a key role in supporting innovation and efficiency across our global organization.

Responsibilities

• You’ll drive the development and improvement of our internal processes, tools, and best practices, collaborating with stakeholders from all Tecan sites.

• You’ll ensure our CAD and PDM systems are always available, up-to-date, and running smoothly, working closely with our IT department.

• You’ll support your colleagues by providing first-level support, sharing your expertise, and helping them get the most out of our systems.

• You’ll test new application versions, prepare and support upgrades, and collect user feedback to make our tools even better.

Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unserer Production Team und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

Production Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Schweiz

Dein Beitrag

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle tragen Sie die technische Verantwortung für ein Produkteportfolio während dem Lifecycle-Management. Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis und Leidenschaft für komplexe Systeme sowie dem Drang nach steter Verbesserung tragen Sie massgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Produkte stets höchsten Kundenansprüchen genügen. Sie stehen als Schnittstelle im Zentrum zwischen der internen/externen Produktion, Forschung & Entwicklung, Beschaffung, Produkt-Management und Qualitätssicherung.

• Technische Betreuung der zugeteilten Produkte von der Freigabe der Nullserie bis zum Phase-out.

• Initiierung und Umsetzung von mechanischen, elektronischen oder Softwareänderungen zusammen mit einem Team von Fachexperten.

• Fehleranalyse und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Planung und Leitung von Prozess Validierungen in unserer Produktion oder bei Lieferanten.

• Entwicklung und Planung der benötigten Produktions- und Prüfmittel

• Prozessbetreuung und -steuerung der zugewiesenen Produktionslinien durch Überwachung der Kennzahlen

• Sicherstellen der Datenqualität im ERP System für eine reibungslose Auftragsabwicklung

• Mitarbeit in LCM-Projekten, um die produktionstechnischen Aspekte einzubringen

• Unterstützung der Qualitätssicherung in technischen Fragen

• Unterstützung des Einkaufs bei technischen Fragen und Aktivitäten mit Lieferanten und Sub-Lieferanten

Dein Profil

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in oder Mechatroniker:in, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung (z.B. Techniker:in HF oder vergleichbar)

• Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Produktion, idealerweise in der Medizintechnik, Bio-Pharma, Automatisierung, Automobil- oder Aviatikindustrie

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Nebst fachlicher Expertise sind wir auch auf der Suche nach einer Persönlichkeit, welche durch proaktives Handeln und dem Drang nach stetiger Verbesserung hervorsticht.

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

· Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

· Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

· Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

· Starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur

· Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work! Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren. Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, welche unsere Anforderungen erfüllen.

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

• Sorgfältige Prüfung und Dokumentation von angelieferten Teilen und Komponenten

Have you ever wondered how your skills and unique background can affect the world of tomorrow? Become part of our Incoming Inspection teams and use the talent and passion that makes you stand out with us.

Measuring technicians (100%)

Nänikon, Zurich

Your contribution

As a metrologist, you are an indispensable part of our team and, with your know-how and quality awareness, ensure that our products meet the highest standards. You are the interface between incoming goods, production and quality management and ensure that only flawless parts and components are used in our production. With your commitment, you make a significant contribution to ensuring that our customers can trust in the reliability and precision of our products.

In your varied everyday work, you serve and program modern 3D measuring machines, independently carry out measurement tasks and document the results carefully. You test delivered parts, options and spare parts according to defined quality standards and analyze the test results together with the team. In case of deviations, you act quickly and solution-oriented to ensure the quality of our products. In addition, you are actively involved in the further development of our quality management system and support the continuous improvement of our processes.

• Operation and programming of 3D measuring machines as well as self-responsible execution of measuring tasks (Zeiss GOM, Mitutoyo)

• Careful testing and documentation of delivered parts and components

• Analysis of test results and close cooperation with the team in finding solutions

• Active participation and further development of our quality management system

Your profile

We are not just looking for expertise: we are looking for people who can put their passion and talent to work with us.

• Completed vocational training, ideally as an automatist, polymechanic or metrologist (AUKOM)

• Further training as a quality technician (alternatively willingness to complete this with us)

• 1+ years of professional experience in quality assurance

• Very good knowledge of German, English skills are advantageous

• High sense of responsibility and quality

• Reliable and consistent working methods

• Strength of communication, team orientation, collegiality and tolerance

• Flexibility, willingness to learn and openness to new things

• Efficient and targeted workflow

What makes working at Tecan unique?

• The opportunity to make a difference and shape the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• Exciting career opportunities

• Strong and unique corporate culture

• Attractive remuneration and benefits

Become a part of Tecan, certified as Great Place to Work! Here you can find out more about our certification. Great place to work.

We look forward to your online application. For your application, we only need your CV (without photo and without letters of motivation, certificates and diplomas are optional).

We can only consider applications that meet our requirements.

#Measurement technician #Quality assurance #Labor automation #LifeScience #CareerTecan #Teamwork #Innovation #Precision #TechnologyJobs #SwissJobs #Quality Management #TecanJobs #Nänikon #Engineering #Manufacturing #JobSwitzerland #MakeItCount

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Messtechniker (100%)

Nänikon, Zürich

Dein Beitrag

Als Messtechniker bist du ein unverzichtbarer Teil unseres Teams und sorgst mit deinem Know-how und deinem Qualitätsbewusstsein dafür, dass unsere Produkte höchsten Ansprüchen genügen. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Wareneingang, Produktion und Qualitätsmanagement und stellst sicher, dass nur einwandfreie Teile und Komponenten in unsere Fertigung gelangen. Mit deinem Engagement trägst du massgeblich dazu bei, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf die Zuverlässigkeit und Präzision unserer Produkte vertrauen können.

In deinem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag bedienst und programmierst du moderne 3D-Messmaschinen, führst eigenständig Messaufträge durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig. Du prüfst angelieferte Teile, Optionen und Ersatzteile nach festgelegten Qualitätsstandards und analysierst die Prüfergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem Team. Bei Abweichungen handelst du schnell und lösungsorientiert, um die Qualität unserer Produkte sicherzustellen. Ausserdem bringst du dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems ein und unterstützt bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse.

• Bedienung und Programmierung von 3D-Messmaschinen sowie eigenverantwortliche Durchführung von Messaufträgen (Zeiss GOM, Mitutoyo)

• Sorgfältige Prüfung und Dokumentation von angelieferten Teilen und Komponenten

• Analyse von Prüfergebnissen und enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team bei der Lösungsfindung

• Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems

Dein Profil

Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, idealweise als Automatiker, Polymechaniker oder Messtechniker (AUKOM)

• Weiterbildung zum Qualitätstechniker (alternativ Bereitschaft, diese bei uns zu absolvieren)

• 1+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unserer Operations Teams und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

Technischer Redakteur (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Dein Beitrag

In dieser anspruchsvollen und wichtigen Funktion bist du für die zielgruppengerechte Erstellung, Verwaltung und den Unterhalt der technischen Dokumente für die bei Tecan hergestellten Produkte für Endbenutzer, Service- und Produktions-Mitarbeitende verantwortlich.

• Erstellen von Benutzerdokumentationen (vorwiegend in Englisch) wie Operating-, Service- und Software-Manuals

• Erstellen von Montageanleitungen und Prüfanweisungen für die Herstellung von Produkten

• Zielgruppengerechte Inhaltserstellung und -pflege im XML-basierten CMS (Schema ST4) und in der DTP-Anwendung (Adobe FrameMaker)

• Einhalten und Umsetzen von regulatorischen Anforderungen

• Implementieren dokumentationsrelevanter Inhalte aus der Risikoanalyse

• Produktfotografie und Bildbearbeitung

• Erstellen von technischen Illustrationen aus 2D- und 3D-Daten

• Erstellen oder Redigieren von Texten in Englisch und Deutsch

• Koordinieren von Übersetzungsaufträgen und Terminologiemanagement

Dein Profil

Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Du bist eine sprachaffine und exakte Person und hast grossen Spass daran, unterschiedliche Anleitungen zu aktualisieren/erstellen.

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Technischer Redakteur oder über ein Studium der Technischen Redaktion samt Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit den gängigen DTP-, Illustrations- und  Bildbearbeitungstools (FrameMaker, Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Schema ST4.

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit einer gängigen 3D-Illustrations-Software (Creo Illustrate, 3DViaComposer oder vergleichbare Software).

• Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- (C1 min.) und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Du kannst andere miteinbeziehen, um zu den notwendigen Informationen zu gelangen.

• Du kannst relevante Informationen herausfiltern und eine zielgruppengerechte Dokumentation aufbereiten, welche regulatorische und firmenspezifische Anforderungen erfüllt.

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

• Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unserer Operations Teams und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

Technischer Redakteur (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Dein Beitrag

In dieser anspruchsvollen und wichtigen Funktion bist du für die zielgruppengerechte Erstellung, Verwaltung und den Unterhalt der technischen Dokumente für die bei Tecan hergestellten Produkte für Endbenutzer, Service- und Produktions-Mitarbeitende verantwortlich.

• Erstellen von Benutzerdokumentationen (vorwiegend in Englisch) wie Operating-, Service- und Software-Manuals

• Erstellen von Montageanleitungen und Prüfanweisungen für die Herstellung von Produkten

• Zielgruppengerechte Inhaltserstellung und -pflege im XML-basierten CMS (Schema ST4) und in der DTP-Anwendung (Adobe FrameMaker)

• Einhalten und Umsetzen von regulatorischen Anforderungen

• Implementieren dokumentationsrelevanter Inhalte aus der Risikoanalyse

• Produktfotografie und Bildbearbeitung

• Erstellen von technischen Illustrationen aus 2D- und 3D-Daten

• Erstellen oder Redigieren von Texten in Englisch und Deutsch

• Koordinieren von Übersetzungsaufträgen und Terminologiemanagement

Dein Profil

Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Du bist eine sprachaffine und exakte Person und hast grossen Spass daran, unterschiedliche Anleitungen zu aktualisieren/erstellen.

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Technischer Redakteur oder über ein Studium der Technischen Redaktion samt Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit den gängigen DTP-, Illustrations- und Bildbearbeitungstools (FrameMaker, Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Schema ST4.

• Du hast gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit einer gängigen 3D-Illustrations-Software (Creo Illustrate, 3DViaComposer oder vergleichbare Software).

• Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- (C1 min.) und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Du kannst andere miteinbeziehen, um zu den notwendigen Informationen zu gelangen.

• Du kannst relevante Informationen herausfiltern und eine zielgruppengerechte Dokumentation aufbereiten, welche regulatorische und firmenspezifische Anforderungen erfüllt.

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

• Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work! Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren. Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, welche unsere Anforderungen erfüllen.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #TechnischeDokumentation #Produktedokumentation #Illustrationen #Technikredaktor #Übersetzungsmanagement

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Finance and Controlling team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior IT Data Analyst (100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

• Analyze and visualize business data to support decision-making

• Develop, optimize, and maintain SAP HANA models and reporting solutions

• Integrate data from ERP, CRM, finance, and other systems

• Create dashboards and KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud; explore new BI tools.

• Lead or support BI and digital transformation projects

• Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance (e.g., GDPR)

• Provide 2nd/3rd level support and training to business users

• Document data flows, models, and methodologies

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Extensive experience as a data analyst/BI specialist in SAP HANA

• Strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere, SAP ERP (S/4), SAP Analytics Cloud, and ETL tools

• Experience in data modeling, SQLScript, and performance optimization

• Understanding of SAP S4 data structures (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP)

• Excellent analytical, communication, and project management skills

• Hands on experience in Project Management

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

• Team player with a structured, independent work style.

• Degree in business IT, data science, or similar is a nice to have

• Experience with OneStream, Salesforce TableauNext, PowerBI would be a plus

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Robotics team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering)

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

• Experience in sensing technologies and motor control systems is a plus

• Strong sense of ownership with the motivation to take responsibility and drive projects to successful completion

• Good written and spoken English skills; German language skills is a plus

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

titleByLocale.fr: Manager Stratégique de Prix et d'Analyse

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?

Tecan is a pioneer and a globally leading company in laboratory automation and a healthcare enabler. The company is improving people’s lives and health by empowering customers to scale healthcare innovation globally. Tecan enables customers to scale their innovation, whether in laboratory workflows for life science research, various applied markets and diagnostics or in product development and manufacturing for the medical market. Tecan delivers this broad range of healthcare products and services directly to end users or with OEM partners.

Are you ready to drive strategic impact on a global scale? As our Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of our transformation toward value-based pricing, shaping the way we define and measure commercial success. Join our Global Commercial  Excellence team and become the champion for pricing innovation and commercial metrics—partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams to embed best practices and ensure transparency across the organization. If you’re passionate about analytics, collaboration, and making a difference, this is your opportunity to lead change and elevate our commercial performance worldwide!

Manager Strategic Pricing & Analytics 100%

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution
 Join our Global Commercial Excellence team as a Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager! In this pivotal role you will:

•    Drive with the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of value-based pricing approaches across products, markets, and customer segments.
 •    Support new product development and launches with pricing analyses, price recommendations, and business case assessments
 •    Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to define a new global pricing policy and governance
 •    Build analytical models and methodologies to support value-based price setting, price differentiation, and price positioning
 •    Define and standardize metrics, with focus on pricing, such as price realization, discount rate, deal margin, and value capture indicators
 •    Design and maintain pricing analytics dashboards, tools, and reporting that enable pricing execution and monitoring
 •    Drive and own the global annual price adjustments process and coordinate its implementation

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. The position requires the following:

Hard / Technical Skills
 •    BA / MBA preferably in STEM
 •    Min 5 years of experience in pricing management and commercial analytics
 •    Strong understanding of pricing and commercial metrics
 •    Understanding of value-based pricing principles and value capture mechanisms in B2B environments
 •    Demonstrated experience designing dashboards and reports that support pricing and commercial decisions (e.g., in PowerBI or Tableau)
 •    Ability to build and interpret pricing models, scenario analyses, and what-if simulations
 •    Proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel (advanced), SQL, Python/R, or BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
 •    Excellent level of English – any additional languages are of added value
 •    Passion for life sciences / healthcare topics

Soft Skills
 •    Ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders across all levels
 •    Strong team player with strong oral & written communication skills
 •    Proactive & takes initiative to get things done
 •    Can-do mindset
 •    Well organized and able to structure fast moving projects
 •    Takes accountability for own work and is firmly focused on results
 •    Eager to learn, explore new ideas & opportunities on a day-to-day basis

What makes working at Tecan unique
 •    You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.
 •    The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow
 •    Working in an international and diverse environment
 •    The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both legal excellence and business impact.
 •    Feel empowered by our strong and unique Tecan culture

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?

Tecan is a pioneer and a globally leading company in laboratory automation and a healthcare enabler. The company is improving people’s lives and health by empowering customers to scale healthcare innovation globally. Tecan enables customers to scale their innovation, whether in laboratory workflows for life science research, various applied markets and diagnostics or in product development and manufacturing for the medical market. Tecan delivers this broad range of healthcare products and services directly to end users or with OEM partners.

Are you ready to drive strategic impact on a global scale? As our Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of our transformation toward value-based pricing, shaping the way we define and measure commercial success. Join our Global Commercial Excellence team and become the champion for pricing innovation and commercial metrics—partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams to embed best practices and ensure transparency across the organization. If you’re passionate about analytics, collaboration, and making a difference, this is your opportunity to lead change and elevate our commercial performance worldwide!

Manager Strategic Pricing & Analytics 100%

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution
Join our Global Commercial Excellence team as a Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager! In this pivotal role you will:

• Drive with the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of value-based pricing approaches across products, markets, and customer segments.
• Support new product development and launches with pricing analyses, price recommendations, and business case assessments
• Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to define a new global pricing policy and governance
• Build analytical models and methodologies to support value-based price setting, price differentiation, and price positioning
• Define and standardize metrics, with focus on pricing, such as price realization, discount rate, deal margin, and value capture indicators
• Design and maintain pricing analytics dashboards, tools, and reporting that enable pricing execution and monitoring
• Drive and own the global annual price adjustments process and coordinate its implementation

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. The position requires the following:

Hard / Technical Skills
• BA / MBA preferably in STEM
• Min 5 years of experience in pricing management and commercial analytics
• Strong understanding of pricing and commercial metrics
• Understanding of value-based pricing principles and value capture mechanisms in B2B environments
• Demonstrated experience designing dashboards and reports that support pricing and commercial decisions (e.g., in PowerBI or Tableau)
• Ability to build and interpret pricing models, scenario analyses, and what-if simulations
• Proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel (advanced), SQL, Python/R, or BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
• Excellent level of English – any additional languages are of added value
• Passion for life sciences / healthcare topics

Soft Skills
• Ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders across all levels
• Strong team player with strong oral & written communication skills
• Proactive & takes initiative to get things done
• Can-do mindset
• Well organized and able to structure fast moving projects
• Takes accountability for own work and is firmly focused on results
• Eager to learn, explore new ideas & opportunities on a day-to-day basis

What makes working at Tecan unique
• You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.
• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow
• Working in an international and diverse environment
• The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both legal excellence and business impact.
• Feel empowered by our strong and unique Tecan culture
• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

You will dive deep into sales and market data, uncovering insights that drive strategic decisions and commercial excellence. By combining your consulting mindset with advanced analytical skills, you will transform complex information into clear, actionable recommendations and compelling stories that support business growth across Europe. Your ability to communicate effectively and collaborate across functions will empower teams to make fact-based decisions and achieve ambitious goals.

• Degree in Business, Science or Engineering

Combinando la tua mentalità da consulente con capacità analitiche avanzate, trasformerai informazioni complesse in raccomandazioni chiare e attuabili e storie avvincenti che supportano la crescita del business in tutta Europa. Capacità di influenzare e guidare oltre i confini organizzativi e di lavorare efficacemente in team interfunzionali. Disponibilità a trasferte internazionali secondo necessità.
